visualCharacteristics.purpose: News/feature slider: one slide at a time with media on one side and a text panel (eyebrow, heading, description, CTA) on the other
visualCharacteristics.layout: Each slide: image left, light-grey text panel right (eyebrow, H3, description, small grey CTA bottom-right); arrows beside the section heading.

contentPattern.description: 5-slide news/feature carousel: image or video, optional eyebrow, H3, description, CTA.
contentPattern.structure: One row per slide: cell 1 image (or a link to an .mp4 with an optional poster image); cell 2 optional eyebrow paragraph, H3, description, CTA link

usage: News/feature slider: one slide at a time with media on one side and a text panel (eyebrow, heading, description, CTA) on the other.
reuseGuidance: Use for sliders of split image/text slides. Use carousel-hero for full-bleed photo slides.
labels: Screen-reader labels can be overridden with page metadata keys carousel-label-role-description, carousel-label-previous, carousel-label-next.
